info.description:
Generated from the live Flask url_map — see potato/server_utils/openapi_spec.py.

Most endpoints are session-authenticated: POST /auth with `username` and `password` as form data, then reuse the session cookie. `x-potato-auth` records the decorators guarding an operation, and `x-potato-requires-config` marks operations that only exist when the named config is enabled.

Response schemas are intentionally not modelled; this spec is an authoritative index of what exists, not a payload contract.
